## Chromosome results

```{r, results='asis'}
figureGALLERY("Target Imputation")
```

```{r}
tableVIEW(imputationQC, "Typed input, retained output, imputed variant counts, and the applied DR2 threshold by chromosome.")
```

```{r}
tableVIEW(imputationDR2, "Imputed variant counts in each Beagle DR2 quality bin by chromosome.")
```

## Reusable imputed checkpoint

```{r}
tableVIEW(imputationMANIFEST, "Chromosome-level VCF and index handoff contract for reuse without repeating imputation.")
```

## Outputs and logs

```{r}
fileTABLE("^(target_imputation|logs/target_imputation)/", "Imputed target manifests, quality summaries, VCF/PGEN checkpoint records, and Beagle logs.")
```

<div class="dnaprs-closing-card">
<p>A passed imputation checkpoint requires a matching reference bundle, successful chromosome-level processing, and retention of typed variants plus newly imputed variants meeting the declared DR2 threshold. It does not establish phenotype prediction.</p>
</div>
